messages.text: Reminder: league table submission to the data provider is due EOD Wednesday. I need every closed and announced deal from Q2 and YTD confirmed on the tracker by tomorrow noon. Please check deal values, role credit, and completion dates.
On it. I'm reconciling the tracker against the signed engagement letters now. A couple of rows still show pre-announcement values, so I'll flag those.
Quick question: for Osprey, are we submitting as sole financial advisor or joint? Last version of the tracker had it as joint, but I thought the other bank dropped off.
Checking the file. The engagement letter amendment from June lists us as sole advisor on the sell-side. I'll update the tracker and note the source in the comments column.
Perfect, thanks Aisha. That moves us up a couple of spots in the mid-market advisory ranking, I think.
Kestrel: do we count it as announced or completed? Regulatory approval is still pending, so I'd say announced only, with no completed credit until closing.
Agreed, announced only. Make sure the enterprise value includes assumed debt the way the provider's methodology requires. Erik, can you pull the footnote on that?
Yes, pulling it now. Their methodology says to include net debt assumed and exclude contingent earnouts unless they're fixed at signing. I'll paste the exact wording in the thread shortly.
Pasted into the tracker's methodology tab. Kestrel has an earnout that is contingent, so we exclude it. That trims the headline value a bit.
Tracker reconciled. Two deals had stale values and one had the wrong completion date. All fixed and highlighted in yellow. Ready for review.
Thanks Susan. Joshua and Tom, please do a final review pass tomorrow morning. I'll sign off and send the file Wednesday midday, ahead of the cutoff.
